records.name: Lambda Upgrader
records.effects:
each time an ore is upgraded there is a 1 - 1.5 / upgrade Count chance to destroy the ore. 

If it survives it has a 1/19  chance to multiply by 3.2, 1/19 chance to add 1,000, 1/19 to create an explosion, 1/19 chance to set the ore value to 1, 1/19 chance for your ore to fling and get multiply by 2.2, 1/19 chance to multiply by 6 and apply sparkle effect to the ore, and a 13/19 chance to multiply by 2.2.

Total survival Chance= 1.5^(n-1) / n!

On the Green Circle Phase: it gives all ore 3x that comes into contact.
On the Yellow Triangle Phase: it gives all ore +30K that come into contact with it.
